HDD Navigation System Function Outline
The 09 model year HDD navigation system mainly has the following functions. Some functions may not be available depending on the presence of options or the content of the contract.
HDD Navigation System Function Overview List
Mode Item Main Functions
Navigation Navigation screen display and operation
Settings/Edit Navigation Volume setting, guidance cancel, route change, memory point registration/editing, map update, navigation detailed settings
Telephone Volume setting, telephone selection, phonebook editing, Bluetooth settings, telephone detailed settings
Audio Audio player switching, Bluetooth audio settings, sound library editing, CD to HDD recording settings
G-BOOK Communication settings, My Request editing, G-SOUND deletion, privacy settings, G-BOOK detailed settings
Driving Support Safe/comfortable driving settings
Maintenance Item settings, dealer settings, maintenance detailed settings
ETC Notification settings
Information/G Telephone Display of traffic/navigation related information and hands-free screen
Congestion Prediction Display of traffic congestion forecast information
VICS Display of VICS graphic information and text information, selection of VICS broadcasting stations
FM Multiplex Display of FM multiplex broadcasting
ETC Display of ETC screen
Calendar Display of calendar
Operation Guide Display of application operating instructions
HELPNET Emergency call via HELPNET
Main Menu Display of main menu screen
G-SOUND Display of G-SOUND screen
My Request Display of My Request screen
Operator Use of operator service
Information Check Checking information obtained through operator service
Drive Plan Downloading drive plans
Map Update Map update operation
Audio Audio operation screen display and operation
Communication Hands-free Calling Hands-free call display and operation
Data Communication Display and operation of G-BOOK online services, and notification, display and operation with the "HELPNET" emergency notification system
Image Quality Adjustment Adjustment of image quality
When using a Bluetooth compatible mobile phone. When using a Bluetooth compatible mobile phone, check on the G-BOOK website that the model has been verified for operation.
When a Bluetooth compatible mobile phone is connected. To use G-BOOK, a start-of-use operation must be performed from the on-board unit.
When a Bluetooth compatible mobile phone is connected. To use HELPNET, the start of G-BOOK online service use on the on-board unit and the HELPNET service start-of-use operation must be completed. (For G-BOOK mX, Web registration is required.) &T120021A807A865;
